name: evaluation_id
description: Evaluation run id this flag belongs to; joins to evaluation_data_history.evaluation_id.

name: table_name
description: Table this flagged row belongs to.

name: rank
description: Rank of this flagged row within its check (1 = most extreme).

name: synthetic_key
description: The synthetic row's handle: its primary-key tuple, else its identity tuple, as JSON (NULL when the table declares neither). It is the synthetic table's own key, so for a full-row copy it equals the copied source row's key.

name: source_key_hash
description: Keyed hash (the evaluation's label key, h:<8 hex>) of the matched source record: its primary-key hash, else its identity hash, else its record hash; NULL for a full-source copy whose source key is not known.

name: source_key
description: Always NULL: raw source keys are never written.

name: distance
description: Distance between the synthetic row and its matched source row.
